title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 14
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system requires a
options: Verbal approval from the manager of the mine
No approval is needed at all here
The written approval of the inspector
Written permission from the manager
questions.solution: Written permission from the manager is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The purpose of drifting includes
options: Exploration, development, ventilation, and access
Storage of coal in the district alone
The housing of the pumping machinery alone
Storing of explosives underground alone
questions.solution: Exploration, development, ventilation, and access.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'included angle' traverse uses
options: The exterior angles at the traverse stations
The bearings that are read with a compass only
The distances that are measured with a survey tape only here
Interior angles measured between adjacent traverse lines
questions.solution: Interior angles between adjacent traverse lines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that all explosions
options: They are always left unused in the mine store
They are always carried home after the long shift hours here
They are then handed over to the mine visitors
Are accounted for - both used and unused cartridges
questions.solution: All explosions must be accounted for - used and unused.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The cross-sectional area of the roadway affects
options: The quantity of stone dust required for dusting
The cost of the shot firing operation
The number of persons who can pass at once
The depth of the roof bolt installed
questions.solution: Affects the quantity of stone dust required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'post-rescue debriefing' covers
options: Lessons learned, equipment performance, and improvements
The monthly salary paid to the rescue team members
The number of the mine rescuers involved in the incident
No such debriefing of the team is needed at all
questions.solution: Debriefings cover lessons, performance, improvements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Spontaneous heating of coal occurs due to
options: The friction of the roof against the mine props
The absorption of moisture by the coal seam of the mine
An external flame or any other ignition source in the mine area
Chemical reaction of coal with oxygen at low temperature
questions.solution: Chemical reaction of coal with oxygen at low temperature.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The personal dust sampler is worn by
options: Workers to measure their personal dust exposure
A person other than the worker exposed
The safety officer of the whole mine area
The manager of the whole mine only here
questions.solution: Workers wear personal dust samplers to measure exposure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ramp width' must accommodate
options: Only the width of a single dumper
The width of the dragline boom
Two-way traffic with adequate clearance
The height of the bench face here
questions.solution: Ramp widths accommodate two-way traffic with clearances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety pillar' near water-logged workings must not be
options: Maintained at all times without change
Reinforced with the steel straps only
Doubled at each of the depillaring stages
Reduced or removed without proper precautions
questions.solution: Must not be reduced or removed without proper precautions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'distribution list' of a report should include
options: All persons who need the information to act
No one in the whole mine area at all
The typist of the mine office only
The inspector of mines in the area
questions.solution: The distribution list ensures the report reaches everyone who needs the information to act on it.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'borehole pressure' near water bodies must be monitored because
options: It is measured by the surveyor only
It is measured once in five years only
High pressure indicates potential blowout risk
It is recorded in the annual report only
questions.solution: Pressure monitoring prevents blowout risks near water bodies.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'steel strap' in roof support is used to
options: Connect multiple bolts for distributed support
Keep the roof bolts clear of the blasting zone
To support the roadway crossing area
To reduce the number of roof bolts required here
questions.solution: Steel straps connect bolts for distributed support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine reject' as stowing material has advantage of
options: Utilizing mining waste at low cost
A high cost of the material transport
Low availability of the waste material
A high quality of the waste material
questions.solution: Mine reject utilizes waste at low cost.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'Board of Examiners' for granting competency certificates is constituted by
options: The manager
The workers
The owner
The Central Government
questions.solution: The Central Government constitutes the Board of Examiners.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Approaching a goaf, probing shall be carried out ahead of the working for at least:
options: 3 m
5 m
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 147: the working is probed ahead for at least 1.5 m beyond the last support before approaching the goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'dowel' in mining support is a
options: Short bolt used for skin support
A ventilation device or appliance only
A long bolt for deep support
The type of explosive being used here
questions.solution: Dowels are short bolts used for immediate skin support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'backup pump' in a mine must be
options: It is stored in the mine store room in an unassembled state
It is fitted only during the monsoon season
Ready for immediate use in case the primary pump fails
It is simply not needed at all in the mine area
questions.solution: Ready for immediate use in case of primary pump failure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Regulation 153 of CMR 2017, the manager must ensure that
options: The mine is mechanically ventilated only in the rainy season
The mine is ventilated only when the inspector visits
The mine is adequately ventilated at all times
Ventilation is a matter of the manager's choice
questions.solution: Regulation 153 (Standard of ventilation) of CMR 2017 requires adequate ventilation to be constantly provided in all parts of the mine belowground.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The operator of a man riding system must
options: Be the sirdar
Be trained and competent
Be any worker
Be the manager
questions.solution: The operator must be trained and competent.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'dust control plan' must include
options: Painting of all the mine haul roads white daily
There are no specific requirements here
Watering only the mine office lawns every single day here
Water spraying, chemical suppressants, enclosed cabs
questions.solution: Dust control uses multiple methods.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'monitoring system' for stowing must track
options: The colour of the sand that is used
The brand name of the water pump only
The number of the workers on shift
Fill level, pressure, and water return rates
questions.solution: Fill level, pressure, and water return rates.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation management' in case of underground fire is important because
options: To control the humidity in the underground mine workings
To improve the lighting of the underground workings area only here
It controls oxygen supply and helps direct smoke away from miners
It is not at all a controlled device in the mine area
questions.solution: Controls oxygen supply and directs smoke away.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team leader' must have
options: No specific qualification is needed here
Any willing worker of the mine area
The longest serving miner in the team
Rescue team leader certification and experience
questions.solution: Team leaders need certification and experience.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be maintained by
options: It is serviced only in the monsoon season
Competent persons under the supervision of the manager
Any worker of the whole underground mine area
The contractor of the mine project works here only in the area
questions.solution: Competent persons under manager's supervision.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'GPS survey' in mining provides
options: Three-dimensional positioning for surface surveys
The tonnage of the coal that is despatched
The depth of the workings below the seam
The rate of the roof fall every month
questions.solution: GPS surveys provide 3D positioning for surface surveys.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosion prevention' in coal mines includes
options: No such prevention is needed in the mine area
Ventilation, gas monitoring, and ignition source control
It is used only for the stemming operations
It is used for increasing the mine coal output of the area
questions.solution: Prevention includes ventilation, monitoring, ignition control.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A new man riding system must be approved by
options: The contractor of the mine project works
The Director General of Mines of India
The office of the mine workers' union
The manager before it is brought into use
questions.solution: Manager's approval is required before use.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main disadvantage of SDL compared to LHD is
options: Limited maneuverability and lower capacity
A much higher operating speed only
A much longer hauling distance here
A much higher haulage capacity overall
questions.solution: Limited maneuverability and lower capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'roof indicator' in mines is used to
options: It is used to measure the mine gas
It is used to measure the temperature
Record roof conditions and changes over time
It is used to measure the air flow
questions.solution: Roof indicators record conditions and changes over time.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'production working' in mining involves
options: Extracting coal from developed faces
The driving of the mine galleries only
The planting of the trees nearby
The building of the roads nearby
questions.solution: Production working extracts coal from developed faces.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue agreement' between mines includes
options: Verbal mutual help between the mine workers
A one-time donation to a charity only
Mutual aid arrangements for emergency response
A letter written to the local press
questions.solution: Mutual aid agreements provide emergency response support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'final highwall' is left at
options: It is vertical in all cases only here
Stable angle of repose for the material
It can be any angle for the material
It is flat at the surface level only
questions.solution: Final highwalls are at stable angle of repose.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A shuttle car is used for
options: The supporting of the mine roof and the ribs in the area
The cutting of the mine coal from the seam
The drilling of the mine round blast holes
Transporting coal from continuous miner to belt conveyor
questions.solution: Transports coal from continuous miner to belt conveyor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue team' must be trained at least
options: Once a year
Once in 5 years
Only after a disaster
Never
questions.solution: Mine rescue teams must be trained at least annually.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shield' support in longwall mining protects against
options: Firedamp entering the working face
The control of the dust emissions here
Goaf material falling onto the working face
The water leaking from the mine roof
questions.solution: Shields protect the working face from goaf material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'leg' in a hydraulic roof support provides
options: To prevent the water ingress into it
There is no support at all in mine
It is a horizontal support force here
Vertical support force to the canopy
questions.solution: Legs provide vertical support force to the canopy.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal seam permeability' affects
options: Gas drainage and water ingress characteristics
The tonnage of coal extracted per month
The colour of the seam floor workings
The number of vehicles on the haul road
questions.solution: Permeability affects gas drainage and water ingress.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stress cell' in strata monitoring is used to
options: To measure the gas concentration only
To measure the temperature only here
Measure stress changes in rock or support
To measure the air flow in roadways
questions.solution: Stress cells measure stress changes in rock or support systems.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A water dam in a mine is constructed to
options: To cool the mine air only in the surface area
To measure the inflow of water into the mine
To increase the rate of the coal extraction from the seam
Impound water and prevent it from entering working areas
questions.solution: Impound water and prevent it from entering working areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosive limit' of methane in air is
questions.solution: Methane explosive limit is 5-15% concentration in air.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drift maintenance' includes
options: Only the whitewashing of the mine surface walls
Only the replacement of the warning signs only
The ventilation of the surface offices
Support repair, drainage, and ventilation checks
questions.solution: Drift maintenance includes support, drainage, ventilation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'summary' of a report should be
options: A concise overview of key findings and recommendations
It is to use informal and simple language only
It is to be highly detailed and lengthy in form
It is much longer than the written mine report of the area
questions.solution: A concise overview of key findings and recommendations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'power to search' a mine lies with
options: The inspector of mines
The workers
The contractor
The manager
questions.solution: The inspector of mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'subsidence' due to mining is controlled by
options: It permits complete extraction without delay
It involves ignoring the subsidence effects
Stowing, pillar design, and controlled extraction
It involves removal of the surface buildings
questions.solution: Subsidence is controlled by stowing, pillars, and extraction methods.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'lower explosive limit' (LEL) of methane is
questions.solution: LEL of methane is 5% concentration in air.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Persons with disabilities are permitted on man riding systems
options: With proper arrangements as per regulations
It is never allowed under any condition
It is done only on the surface of the mine
It is done without any restriction at all
questions.solution: With proper arrangements as per regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'mine emergency' can include
options: A minor delay in the dispatch of the coal from the whole mine area
A routine change of the mine shift timing every single day at the site
Fire, explosion, inundation, roof fall, gas outburst, and other emergencies
A routine breakdown of the mine equipment in that area only
questions.solution: Fire, explosion, inundation, roof fall, gas outburst, and others.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: While driving approaching old or waterlogged workings, advance boreholes shall be kept at least ______ ahead of the face.
options: 3 m
1 m
6 m
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 163: at least 3 advance boreholes not less than 3 m ahead of the face, with flank holes within 5 m on either side.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water dam seepage' must be monitored because
options: Seepage can lead to dam failure if excessive
It is monitored only during the rains here
It is checked once in every year only
It reduces the mine ventilation supply
questions.solution: Excessive seepage can lead to dam failure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The purpose of man riding systems in mines is to
options: Transport of the equipment to the face
Increase the tonnage handled per shift
Carry the shotfirers to the firing point
Transport persons safely and reduce fatigue
questions.solution: Man riding systems transport persons safely and reduce fatigue.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'planimeter' in mine surveying is used to measure
options: The angle of a mine traverse line
Area of irregular shapes on plans
The volume of the blasted rock mass
The distance between points
questions.solution: Planimeters measure area of irregular shapes on plans.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rock bolting' for drift support is installed
options: It is not needed in the mine drift
As the drift advances, following the face
It is used to support conveyor belts
It is done after the drift is completed
questions.solution: Rock bolts are installed as the drift advances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An effective report uses
options: The long sentences that are full of technical jargon everywhere
The very long paragraphs that are used in the whole report of the mine
The personal opinions of the report writer only here
Simple language, short sentences, and technical terms as appropriate
questions.solution: Simple language, short sentences, and appropriate technical terms.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'shotcrete' application in a drift is used to
options: To replace the mine winding rope here
Provide surface support and seal the rock face
To pump the accumulated mine water out
To dress the benches of the open pit
questions.solution: Provides surface support and seals the rock face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar shall verify that the permissible explosives
options: Are used for all shots
Are used only where permitted
Are stored underground
Are never used in the mine area
questions.solution: Permissible explosives must be used only where permitted.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The employment of children in mines is
options: They are permitted above fourteen years
Permitted with restrictions
Prohibited under the Mines Act 1952
They are allowed for the light work only
questions.solution: Prohibited under the Mines Act 1952.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: On the occurrence of a misfire, the hole shall:
options: They are abandoned for one week at least in the whole mine area without probe
Not be probed, and the shot shall be dealt with by the shot-firer of the next shift
They are probed at once with a long heavy steel rod by the hand only
They are refired by the same shot-firer without any delay at all
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 204: a misfired hole is not probed; it is dealt with by the shot-firer of the succeeding shift, with a report to the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A mine rescue team must be trained
options: At regular intervals as prescribed
Only after a major mine disaster
Only during the major mine disasters
Only once in every five years here
questions.solution: At regular intervals as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Misfire in underground coal mines is reported within
options: 12 hours
24 hours
7 days
48 hours
questions.solution: Misfires must be reported within 24 hours to the authority.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety committee in a mine must be
options: Optional at the discretion of the manager of the whole mine area
Constituted under Mines Rules 1955 where more than 100 persons are ordinarily employed
Constituted only for the surface opencast mines of the whole country of ours
Required only in the underground metal mines of the whole country of ours
questions.solution: Rule 29T of the Mines Rules 1955 requires a safety committee to be constituted in every mine where more than 100 persons are ordinarily employed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'interburden' between coal seams is
options: Rock layer between two coal seams
The soil on the surface of the mine
A mineral deposit of the mine area
The coal seam itself in the workings
questions.solution: Interburden is rock between two coal seams.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air sampling' in a mine must be done by
options: The watchman of the mine surface premises only during the day
Any other person of the whole underground mine area
The engineman of the mine winding plant house
A competent person using approved methods and equipment
questions.solution: By a competent person using approved methods.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing thickness' in the goaf determines
options: The colour of the stowing slurry that is used
The rating of the stowing water pumps that are used
The gradient of the coal seam that is worked
The degree of ground support and subsidence control
questions.solution: Degree of ground support and subsidence control.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'surface water management' for mines includes
options: No management practice is needed in mine
Diversion channels, dams, and drainage systems
The rainfall records of the mine area
The painting of the mine sump area around it
questions.solution: Surface water management uses channels, dams, drainage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the 'emergency plan' for a mine must include
options: Evacuation routes, rescue arrangements, and communication procedures
The production targets fixed for the whole mine area
The leave roster that is prepared for the mine workers
The canteen arrangements that are made for all the mine workers here
questions.solution: Regulation 252 of CMR 2017 (Emergency response and evacuation plan) requires evacuation routes, rescue arrangements, and communication procedures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing plant' on surface includes
options: The mine workshop layout and the layout drawings of the mine
Mixing, pumping, and delivery systems for stowing material
The coal washery of the whole mine area only
The winding house layout plan of the mine area
questions.solution: Mixing, pumping, and delivery systems.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: AFC stands for
options: Armoured Face Conveyor
Automatic Face Conveyor
Air Flow Conveyor
Automatic Flow Conveyor
questions.solution: AFC stands for Armoured Face Conveyor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'dip' of a coal seam refers to
options: The thickness of the coal seam that is worked here
The chemical composition of the coal
Angle of inclination of the seam from horizontal
The colour of the coal that is mined
questions.solution: Dip is the angle of inclination from horizontal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team composition' typically includes
options: The general manager of the whole mine area
The company doctor of the whole mine area
Only a single person is permitted to do this here in the mine
Trained miners with specific roles and responsibilities
questions.solution: Rescue teams include trained miners with specific roles.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding rope must be tested for
options: The colour of the mine rope surface strands of the winding rope
Tensile strength, endurance, and non-destructive testing
The measured diameter of the mine winding rope
The purchase price paid for the mine rope only
questions.solution: Tensile strength, endurance, and non-destructive testing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Water-filled blasting holes require special consideration because
options: Water has no effect on the explosives
Water increases efficiency
Water can desensitize explosives
Water makes blasting safer
questions.solution: Water can desensitize explosives and affect initiation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A mine rescue team member must be physically fit and
options: Between 21 and 40 years of age
Above forty years of age in mine
Of any age whatsoever in the mine
There is no age limit prescribed here
questions.solution: Between 21 and 40 years of age.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In every mine, the shot-firer shall be provided with a reserve station (a suitable sheltered place) and, where required:
options: An additional battery of the electric detonator type only
A telephone at every single working face of the underground mine
A relay of persons posted between the shot-firer and the firing station
A second shot-firer posted at the working face only in the mine area
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 193: a RESERVE STATION is provided, with a relay of persons between the shot-firer and the firing station to transmit signals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing cost' depends on
options: The season of the year in that area
Material source, distance, equipment, and labor
A fixed cost figure fixed for every mine area
The colour of the sand that is used
questions.solution: Stowing cost depends on source, distance, equipment, and labor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The electrical equipment zone classification in mines depends on
options: The mechanical strength of the materials
The voltage of the mine power supply system that is used
The likelihood of explosive atmosphere being present
The wish of the mine manager of that area
questions.solution: Likelihood of explosive atmosphere being present.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'artificial support' in mining is required when
options: The mine roof is always solid enough
Natural support is insufficient for safe working
The natural support is adequate enough
It is unnecessary with natural support only
questions.solution: Artificial support is needed when natural support is insufficient.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The primary purpose of mine ventilation is to
options: It increases the temperature of the air
Control humidity in underground workings
Provide fresh air and remove contaminated air
It is only for cooling the face in summer
questions.solution: Ventilation provides fresh air and removes contaminants.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'reportable accident' includes
options: Any injury of a minor nature to any person working here
The loss of a hand lamp device from any person
A single fall of loose roof stone from the seam
Fatal, serious, and dangerous occurrences as defined
questions.solution: Fatal, serious, and dangerous occurrences as defined.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'ventilation regulator' is used to
options: To remove the harmful gases and the dust
To increase the ventilation fan speed
Control the quantity of air flowing in a section
To regulate the air temperature only here
questions.solution: Controls the quantity of air flowing in a section.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'UDAN' scheme is related to
options: Urban housing for all
Regional air connectivity
Digital payments for farmers
High-speed rail corridors
questions.solution: Regional air connectivity.

The absence of geological constraints only
High mechanisation in the underground mines
The low wages paid to the underground mine workers of that area

options: Mine production, transport, and dispatch systems
The colour of the coal that is produced from the mine seam
The mine closures only in the district
The price of the imported coal only here

Wednesday

Rajasthan

The building of more coal-fired plants

The agricultural subsidies to farmers only

M.S. Dhoni

questions.stem: The capital of Chhattisgarh is

Raipur

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mechanized mining' in coal mines uses
options: The hand tools and the carrying baskets
The hand guided drilling and the barrows
The animal drawn carts on the surface of the mine only
Heavy machinery like draglines, shovels, and trucks

questions.stem: The 'National Mineral Policy' was revised in

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal allocation' for power sector follows the
options: Administrative price fixation by the Ministry
Fuel Supply Agreement (FSA) and e-auction
Quarterly allocation by the Railways
Open tender purchase by the buyers

questions.stem: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
options: Son
Ganga
Kosi
Yamuna

questions.subject: General
questions.solution: 215 is not a perfect square.
